title: Three illuminated plus signs over Stockholm suburb

tellings.quote: together with my wife in 1995, November

plain: In November 1995, three lit-up shapes like plus signs were seen in the sky over a suburb of Stockholm, Sweden. A researcher named Clas Svahn tells Michels he saw them himself, together with his wife, and he names a person called Annalie in telling it. If it is what he describes, it is a sighting by someone who has spent years studying such reports.
